method: Built-in image_gen; realistic product photography inspired by simplified GLB, with user-directed industrial-design refinement
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a convincing premium studio PHOTOGRAPH of a real manufacturable compact folding upright exercise bike for an ecommerce catalog.
The input image is ONLY a loose product concept for category, approximate proportions, graphite and burnt-orange color scheme, and warm off-white studio composition. It is NOT a structural blueprint. Deliberately replace its crude blocky 3D model geometry with realistic industrial design. Do not reproduce its rectangular block saddle, slab-like wheel housing, square chopped beam ends or straight toy-like handlebar.
Subject: one compact folding stationary exercise bike, unfolded, approximately 53 cm wide by 98 cm deep by 118 cm tall. Realistic slender crossing steel X-frame, restrained burnt-orange painted main frame and graphite secondary frame, sound bolted central folding hinge and locking adjustment knob. Proper stable transverse floor stabilizers with molded black rubber end caps and small transport rollers. A compact curved matte charcoal injection-molded drive enclosure low in the frame, with natural panel seams, small recessed fasteners and a subtle orange inset. Realistic opposing metal cranks, rubber tread pedals with adjustable black foot straps. Telescoping seat post with height adjustment holes and a locking knob. A genuine contoured bicycle saddle with rounded rear lobes, a narrow forward nose, believable foam thickness and neatly stitched black upholstery—NOT a rectangular cushion. Connected curved tubular ergonomic handlebar with black foam grips and a small practical LCD console, blank muted screen, no large touchscreen. Mechanically coherent, refined domestic fitness equipment with softly rounded manufactured edges, realistic welds, hardware and subtle material variation.
Real commercial product photography, finely textured powder coat, rubber, upholstery and molded plastic, natural specular reflections and soft studio shadows. Same warm off-white seamless floor and background, centered square image, full product visible with generous margins, flattering front three-quarter angle revealing side drive housing and saddle. No dramatic lighting. No people, other objects, logos, branding, text, watermark or dimension labels. Avoid CGI appearance, low-poly shapes, toy proportions, impossible floating parts and overbuilt spin-bike styling.
